services.name: Event Venue Rentals
services.desc: Nestled in a serene pine forest, offers the perfect setting for your special event. Whether you’re planning a wedding, corporate retreat, celebration, or memorial, our tranquil and well-equipped campus provides an inviting space to accommodate you and your guests. The Highlands Center’s beautiful, tranquil campus is a 15-minute drive from downtown Prescott or Prescott Valley, Arizona, off Highway 69 near Costco and surrounding stores and many hotels. Its 80-acre campus is surrounded by millions of acres of Prescott National Forest land.
